KEY TAKEAWAYS
October 28 Grand Opening:
Century Communities will celebrate the Grand Opening of its new neighborhood at Crosswinds in Kyle, TX on October 28, with model home tours, light bites and early-bird savings.
Six floor plans priced from the $400s:
Single-family floor plans at the community will range from 2,013 to 2,811 square feet, with up to 6 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.
3-car garages on oversized homesites:
Every floor plan at Crosswinds will include a standard 3-car garage on an oversized 60' homesite.
Resort-style amenities:

Crosswinds homeowners have access to the Windy Point Amenity Center, with a pool complex and splash park, an off-leash dog park, walking trails, a playground, and pickleball and basketball courts. An elementary school is also planned.
Convenient Austin-area location:
The community sits about 20 miles south of downtown Austin, with proximity to South Austin employers—including Tesla, Amazon, and Dell—and quick access to I-35.
KYLE, Texas, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
Century Communities, Inc. (

a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced the upcoming Grand Opening of its new neighborhood at Crosswinds, a planned community with resort-style amenities in Kyle, Texas, where the builder is introducing six single-family floor plans priced from the $400s.
Slated for October 28, the event will run from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Attendees will be able to tour the Everglade model home, enjoy light bites, and take advantage of Grand Opening savings.
Learn more, join the interest list, and RSVP for the Grand Opening
at

"Crosswinds sits in an ideal location, combining suburban charm with quick access to major Austin-area employers," said Paul Kwiatkowski, Division President. "In addition to exciting amenities, this new community offers a range of modern floor plans that make it easy for buyers to find a home that complements their lifestyle. We invite interested homebuyers to visit our Grand Opening on October 28 to tour our model home, explore the community, and learn about available homes."

Crosswinds is a planned community designed to preserve the surrounding Texas prairie, connected by roads and trails winding through parks and open space. Century Communities homeowners will have access to the Windy Point Amenity Center—a pool complex and splash park, event lawn, and grilling and picnic areas—along with an off-leash dog park, pickleball and basketball courts, a playground, pocket parks and an expanding trail system. A Hays CISD elementary school is planned.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Question:
When is the Grand Opening at Crosswinds in Kyle, TX?
Answer:

Century Communities hosts its Grand Opening at Crosswinds on Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. at 231 Hull Speed Drive in Kyle, TX. The event includes model home tours, light bites, and Grand Opening savings.
Question:
How much do new homes cost at Crosswinds in Kyle, TX?
Answer:
New homes at Crosswinds are priced from the $400s.
Question:
What floor plans does Century Communities offer at Crosswinds?
Answer:
Crosswinds offers six single-family floor plans: Geneva, Norman, Lassen, Savannah, Denali II, and Everglade, ranging from 2,013 to 2,811 square feet
Question:
What schools serve Crosswinds in Kyle, TX?
Answer:
Crosswinds is zoned for Hays CISD, including Pfluger Elementary School, Chapa Middle School, and Lehman High School. A future elementary school is also planned within Crosswinds.
Question:
What amenities are available at Crosswinds?
Answer:

Crosswinds homeowners have access to the Windy Point Amenity Center, with a pool complex and splash park, event lawn, and grilling and picnic areas. The planned community also offers an off-leash dog park, pickleball and basketball courts, pocket parks and nature trails, and a playground.
Question:
How far is Crosswinds from Austin?
Answer:
Crosswinds in Kyle, TX sits about 20 miles south of downtown Austin and 15 miles from South Austin employers including Tesla, Amazon and Dell. San Marcos is 15 miles away, with direct access to I-35.
